thread:
Maya: Pelagic (prospect) wants a staged migration off CompetitorWave. They asked for a drop-in façade with minimal client changes, prompt/slot parity, token-count reconciliation (they call it 'meter'), and an on-prem failback. Can we enumerate blockers and next steps?
Ibrahim: Quick Q — do they require exact path parity or just SDK-friendly minimal diffs? Sales says 'minimal client work', leaning toward behavioral parity not exact path.
Clara: Eng risks: 1) tokenizer divergence -> slot splitting and reranker order changes; 2) CompetitorWave has special stop-sequence semantics; 3) they use a custom X-Req-Session header for session affinity. Also token-counting for templated prompts differs.
Nora: For tokenizer we can ship a small façade that normalizes NFC, collapses whitespace, and applies a compact token-map for top divergences. We'll also provide a tiny client shim to normalize templates before sending.
Ibrahim: We can honor X-Req-Session and implement header-based sticky routing to Dedicated pool for the POC. Need to validate affinity when autoscaling.
Maya: Security/legal asks: HSM-backed keys (FIPS), exportable audit logs, contractual no-training + 90d retention. Contracts wants exact wording for the no-training clause.
contracts-bot: Draft addendum template queued: pelagic-no-train-90d.
deploy-bot: Presales env requested: pelagic-facade-v0 -> staging (job 77021).
Clara: Pricing question from Pelagic: delta if we run quantized variants vs CompetitorWave. Ibrahim, rough $/1k tokens and latency tradeoffs for 8k-ish seq?
Ibrahim: Ballpark: quantized on Dedicated ~0.5-0.75x per-token vs CompetitorWave depending on batch util. Latency p50 +8-18%, p95 varies (+12-35%) with concurrency. I'll add a conservative table to the shared cost workbook.
Maya: Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) Top-1 intent/slot parity >=95% on their eval set; 2) p95 latency within 25% of CompetitorWave under their traffic profile; 3) token-meter reconciliation script + sample report showing <=12% variance after normalization; 4) contractual no-training + 90d retention confirmed. Target POC timeline: 10 business days.
Clara: Workstream tasks: token-meter (Eli) -> build reconciliation script mapping CompetitorWave CSV -> our billing units; tokenizer façade (Clara) -> staging shim + client helper; security (Nora) -> SOC2 excerpts + HSM notes + allowlist IPs; contracts (Maya) -> finalize addendum.
Ibrahim: Smoke test curl to share with customer (staging façade):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/v1/pelagic-facade/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Req-Session: sess-42" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<their prompt>","max_tokens":200,"stop":["\n\n"]}'
```
Maya: Pelagic also asked for a sample reconciliation output format. Proposed CSV columns: original_text, competitor_tokens, redwood_tokens, competitor_count, redwood_count, delta_pct. Is that OK?
Eli: Yes. We'll also include a normalized_token_map column and an explanation of normalization rules applied. Expect typical delta 5-15% depending on template density.
Nora: Uploading SOC2 excerpts and HSM integration notes to presales folder. Also listing required staging egress IPs for their allowlist.
deploy-bot: Job 77021 started: pelagic-facade-v0 staging spin-up.
Clara: Calibration note: stop-sequence mapping can be tricky. We'll run competitor baseline calls on their sample set and produce a small mapping table for stop semantics.
Maya: Action items: Ibrahim -> cost table + baseline runs; Clara -> shim deploy + parity smoke tests; Eli -> reconciliation script + sample report; Nora -> security docs + IP list; Maya -> finalize addendum with contracts-bot.
Ibrahim: If Pelagic can provide the eval set + sample CompetitorWave billing CSV and a CompetitorWave API key by Monday, we keep the 10-business-day target. Otherwise add 1 week.
Maya: I'll request those today and cc legal. Marking thread presales-pelagic-facade for follow-up.
